required_outcomes: Recognises this is the same kitchen extractor fan closed on 21 September, and that the switch fix no longer works (switch on, light on, fan does not run).
Reopens the request or opens a new job linked to it, rather than treating the email as noise on a closed job.
Asks the landlord for approval to send a contractor (or whether he will use his own), telling him the switch was checked and the fan has failed again.
Replies to the tenant: the fault is logged again, the landlord is being asked about a contractor, and when she will next hear, without a visit date.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the tenant for a photo or short video of the hood with the switch on, alongside the landlord request.
positive_behaviours: Cites the earlier request and its closure in the new job or note.
Suggests opening a window while cooking until it is fixed.
red_flags: Telling the tenant to check the switch again when she says she already has.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a contractor without the landlord's approval.
Leaving the job closed with only a reply.
critical_failures: Not acting on the recurrence: no reopened or new job and no request to the landlord.
